jd_text:
Product Designer

Join our product team designing a consumer finance app.

What you'll do:
- Design end-to-end flows in Figma, from wireframes to high-fidelity prototypes
- Plan and run user research and usability testing
- Grow and maintain our design system
- Create 3D illustrations in Blender for marketing launches

Requirements:
- 3+ years of product design experience
- Expert in Figma
- Experience with user research and prototyping
- Blender is a strong plus

resume_content.headline: Product Designer
resume_content.summary: Product designer with four years shaping mobile banking and payments experiences.

Built a component library of 120 parts shared by 3 product squads
Wrote the copy and layouts for 6 app store screenshots
